paragraphs.text: Dark Ascension has two event decks .
Gleeful Flames is a red aggro / burn event deck.
The rares in this deck are Hellrider , Curse of Stalked Prey , Inkmoth Nexus , Inkmoth Nexus , Torpor Orb , Torpor Orb , Torpor Orb .
Spiraling Doom is a black / green event deck. With its centerpiece being Birthing Pod , it is described as being a "Pod" deck.
The rares in this deck are Bloodgift Demon , Hex Parasite , Myr Battlesphere , Solemn Simulacrum , Birthing Pod , Birthing Pod , Grim Backwoods .
